verdict.reason: The query parameter table lists no isAuthor filter, and the comment object says how isAuthor marks audience comments.

steps.text: The List Comments query parameters are limit, cursor, platform, accountId, parentCommentId, postId, since, and until, so isAuthor is not one of them.
Each comment in the response has an isAuthor field, which is false for an audience reply and true when your connected account wrote the comment.
